title: Jeremiah 47
paragraphs: ¹ The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh attacked Gaza. ² This is what the LORD says: "Look — waters are rising from the north; they will become an overflowing torrent. They will overflow the land and everything in it, the towns and their inhabitants. The people will cry out; everyone who lives in the land will wail ³ at the thundering hooves of charging stallions, the rattling of enemy chariots, the rumbling of their wheels. Fathers will not look back for their children — their hands will hang limp, ⁴ because the day has come to destroy all the Philistines and cut off all surviving allies of Tyre and Sidon. The LORD is about to destroy the Philistines, the remnant from the coasts of Caphtor. ⁵ Gaza will shave her head in mourning; Ashkelon will fall silent. Remnant of their power in the valley, how long will you gash yourselves?"

⁶ "O sword of the LORD, how long will you be restless? Return to your scabbard; be still and at rest." ⁷ But how can it rest when the LORD has commanded it? Against Ashkelon and the seacoast — that is where he has assigned it.
